description: An NFA for 'ends in ab' simulated by maintaining a set of current states. The machine has epsilon-free transitions with sets as delta targets. run_nfa advances all states in parallel via set union, accepts if any state in the set is accepting. Trace shows how 'aab' builds {q0,q1} then reaches {q0,q2}.
source: draft: omp free model + edit: codex

steps.description: ENDS_IN_AB_NFA machine: start is frozenset({q0}), accept is frozenset({q2}). delta maps (state, symbol) -> frozenset of next states. q0 on 'a' goes to {q0,q1} (loop or guess ending starts); q0 on 'b' stays {q0}; q1 on 'b' goes to {q2}; q2 has no outgoing transitions.
Key NFA feature: q0 on 'a' branches to two states {q0, q1}  -  the loop continues AND a new path starts that expects 'b' next.

run_nfa: current starts as set of start states. For each input char, nxt = empty set; for each state in current, union delta.get((state,ch), empty) into nxt. current = nxt. If current empty, return False (dead). After loop, accepted = bool(current & accept)  -  intersection test.
Inner loop: for each state, get its successors on this symbol, union into nxt. Missing delta entries return empty frozenset, so that path just dies without killing others.

steps.answer: {q0, q1}  -  first 'a' gives {q0,q1}, second 'a' from q0 gives {q0,q1} and from q1 gives empty (no 'a' transition from q1), union is {q0,q1}.

title: NFA Simulation by Tracking Set of States
